description: Looks up the current UK Global Tariff (third-country/MFN) duty, the Türkiye preferential rate under the UK–Türkiye trade agreement, required documents, import restrictions and trade remedies for an HS commodity code — live from the official UK Trade Tariff API (trade-tariff.service.gov.uk) at call time. Use this instead of answering UK duty-rate questions from memory: UK rates diverge from legacy EU rates and change over time.

hs_code.description: HS / commodity code, 4 to 10 digits (dots, spaces and dashes are tolerated), e.g. '8708' or '3304.99'.

origin_country.description: Optional ISO-2 origin country code. Türkiye ('TR') preference is resolved in full; for other origins the source page link shows origin-specific measures.

name: uk_tariff_lookup
title: Live UK import tariff lookup (official UK Trade Tariff)
